assessments.justification: Collect-sell-upgrade cleaning job maps to the Roblox simulator/tycoon genre (Job Simulator tag).
Core loop is collect dust, sell, upgrade the tool, which is quick to rebuild.
Toothbrush-to-vehicle absurdity with 16 friends produces clippable moments.
Incremental progression suggests 20 to 40 minute sessions.
Tool upgrades and vehicles are natural paid boosters in a simulator.
Generic cleaning mechanic with no recognisable characters.
